verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management and issue-tracking product. Having an agent drive a browser through an app and capture before-and-after screenshots to check its own code is a coding-agent or browser-automation capability, which is a different product role. The evidence shows Shortcut only connects to external agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex through its MCP server. Nothing shows Shortcut itself navigating apps or taking screenshots, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
